name: BiomeDefinition
lead: What a pack changes about the vanilla biome its own biome copies. Each colour is a `Color` or a colour name such as "#7fd8c8".

fields.name: name
fields.description: Lower case letters, digits and underscores. The pack's name goes in front: "crystal" becomes "mypack:crystal".

fields.name: like
fields.description: The vanilla biome to copy; "plains" when left out.

fields.name: water_fog
fields.description: The colour of the view under water.

fields.name: fog
fields.description: The colour of the far distance.
